sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Semiconductor Crisis is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Yesterday, as I was installing a reflex sight onto an M4, I spotted some weird local on the monitor, he seemed to be praying. He painted different signs on the wall and on the floor, then walked into the middle of the circle these symbols formed, and started placing weapons there. To be honest, it didn’t even look strange, it made perfect sense to me. It’s natural for people to offer the most valuable things they have to their gods, and these days it’s weapons. Those are cultists, you might've already encountered them. I have enough power capacity for now. Look for some more graphics cards and coolers. And thanks for the package, by the way."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 14 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 3 Graphics cards in raid
- Find 15 CPU fans in raid
- Hand over 3 Graphics cards to Mechanic
- Hand over 15 CPU fans to Mechanic

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +8,000 EXP
- +3 Attention skill level
- Mechanic Rep +0.02
- 1× Pistol case
- 2× Physical Bitcoin
- 4× Tetriz portable game console
- 1× Glock 17 9x19 pistol (variant Viper)

"Ah, you've returned. I'll try to assemble them till nightfall, thanks. I know, it's really hard to find such electronics during these hard times, but I didn't doubt you."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Graphics card | 3 | Handover item | Yes | Can be crafted in the Hideout (Intelligence Center lv. 3). |
| CPU fan | 15 | Handover item | Yes | |

- CPU fans can be found inside of electronics stores, but are most commonly found inside of PC blocks.

- Graphics cards can be found:
  - In PC blocks
  - In Sport bags
  - Inside Buried barrel cache
  - Inside Ground cache
